attempt_unit: Complete source candidates / actual device-JIT program processes; five timing trials are not five translation attempts.

observed_model_metadata.lookup_method: Latest complete same-stream turn_context not later than the usage event, backward bounded-memory scan.
observed_model_metadata.scope: Observed configured identifier only; exact serving snapshot/seed/temperature unknown. No cross-stream inference and no historical token recovery.

translation_usage.usage_scope: Inclusive ordered workflow and repeated/cached context; cached input is subset of input, reasoning is subset of output. Approximate boundary lag, not exclusive billed cost.

numerical_contract: All returned GPU atom buffers and actual device inputs for every force call; initial47,220-value raw Float64 prefix is bit-exact. All2,517,798 artifact fields per trial compare at absolute2e-6 + relative2e-10. Independent long-double force checks cover every coordinate at all11 steps; additional finite/rigid-distance/total-force checks. Listed host vectors and four statistics are captured; not all CLI bytes or unlisted host statistics.
